series_procedure.per_attempt: scan (mover_scan.py), mover_runner.py check, synthetic (SYN, 4 s hold), paper; recover on needs_attention (never needed)
series_procedure.freeze_plan: The freeze (FREEZE.md, modified 2026-09-28T20:23:08Z) fixes no trial count. It runs trials ext-20260928-N in sequence, each only after the previous one passed or recovered, with the last start at 18:30 ET. It stops the series on a ledger halt, a failed recovery, a preflight refusal or 18:30 ET. Eight attempts ran.
series_procedure.retry: retry-benchmark.sh starts the next attempt 20 s after a preflight refusal benchmark_quotes_not_ready (the preflight found no SPY quote within the engine's freshness bounds: at most 3 s old and no more than 0.25 s ahead), up to its try count; every attempt keeps its own directory and no limit changes
series_procedure.retry_timing: retry-benchmark.sh made the 20 s retry only after the refusals of attempts 4, 5, 6 and 7, inside the chain4 unit (each console gap 20 s). After attempt 2's refusal the operator started the r3 unit 61 s after unit 2 stopped. After attempt 1's refusal the operator started unit 2 65 s after unit 1 stopped.
series_procedure.scan_note: fired counts every symbol that met the rule; the engine scan file keeps the top 5 by rank (max_symbols 5) as candidates
series_procedure.chain: chain-next.sh starts the next unit only after the previous unit ended and the previous trial passed or recovered, and only if the clock is not past 18:30 ET when it checks, once, before handing over to retry-benchmark.sh; retry-benchmark.sh does not check the clock

The modification times of retry-benchmark.sh (20:25:56Z) and chain-next.sh (20:38:43Z) precede the units that ran them and are unchanged since.
deviations_from_freeze: Scanner argument: corrected from G20 to G0.20 after attempt 1 (scanner_rule). Attempt 1 sent no order.

limitations: Volatile scratch checkout: the engine ran from a detached checkout of 3058b237 in a session scratch directory that no longer exists. Code identity rests on the pc-20260928 freeze SHA256SUMS (60 of 196 files, written 4.4 hours before attempt 1) and git show, not on a hash taken at run time (code.clean_basis_limits).
Metadata plus broker-reconciled evidence, not a frozen gate run. It qualifies no gate, including alpaca-paper-extended-hours.
Unconfirmed fills would be marked unconfirmed. This reconciliation found none: 23 of 23 ledger executions matched broker FILL activities.
The broker read uses the same broker API and account as the engine, so it is independent of the engine code but not of the broker.

Alpaca paper fills are simulated by the broker from quotes. They are not exchange executions and do not establish live slippage, queue position or partial-fill behaviour. Here every one of the 23 fills was at its order's reference quote.

Two passed trials in one POST session are not a strategy evaluation. The scanner measures gain against the previous official close, so in POST it selects the day's movers and holds them into after-hours; it does not select after-hours-only catalysts.
The freeze's stop on a preflight refusal was replaced by bounded retries, and the series scripts, including chain-next.sh, were not part of the freeze (series_procedure.deviations_from_freeze).

Account designation: the series kept its own engine ledger (the default paper state root's directory for this account, which holds only this series' two trials) but traded broker account alpaca-paper-2, which blueprints/us-equities/incentive-monitor/forward-protocol-v1.json:63 and docs/secret-storage.md:17 designate as the isolated incentive-monitor study account. The broker account's orders, fills and cash are shared even where engine ledgers are not. Whether this use is compatible with the forward study's isolation is referred to the forward protocol's owner, the trading lane; this receipt does not decide it.

The websocket restart lines carry no timestamp. They are normal-close (1000) records, which an earlier isolation check found only after the engine's stop(); this run neither confirms nor rules that out.

The journal holds no exit record for the r3, chain4 and incentive-monitor units (journal_query). Their success is inferred from the absence of a failure record; the last attempt of r3 and of chain4 logged paper rc 0.
evidence_note: Built from the private trial workspace (the engine's own receipts, consoles and events), the engine mover ledger read with sqlite mode=ro, the systemd user journal, git show 3058b237 and a fresh read-only broker reconciliation (GET only, paper endpoint) whose tool and stdout are committed here. Figures present in two or more of those sources (orders, fills, final statuses, fill prices against reference quotes, P&L, notional, cash delta, gross loss, in-trial request counts and code hashes) were cross-checked by assertion, and a mismatch stops the build. Other fields come from one source; field_provenance names them. No credential, account id, account number, account fingerprint, broker order id or ref, activity id, execution id or host path is recorded.
